title: What Write-Ahead Logging Internals Is All About
description: The WAL: append-only redo that makes crash recovery fast and correct.. This database covers Write-Ahead Logging Internals with full records: definitions, key facts, working procedures, and runnable demo programs, arranged on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. ACID is a contract: atomicity, consistency, isolation, durability.
definition: Write-Ahead Logging Internals — The WAL: append-only redo that makes crash recovery fast and correct.
key_points: ACID is a contract: atomicity, consistency, isolation, durability.
Atomicity means all-or-nothing; undo logs implement it.
Durability means surviving crashes; WAL implements it.
Isolation is a spectrum; serializable is the top.

title: The WAL protocol
description: The WAL protocol. Log records hit stable storage before the data pages they describe, and before commit is acknowledged. This ordering is the whole trick: the log is the truth after a crash. Violating it corrupts; every engine gets this right.

title: Checkpoints

title: WAL vs undo/redo logs
